name: vibe-setup
description: Audit any repository for AI/agent (vibe coding) readiness, scaffold the missing pieces, upgrade an already-set-up repo to a newer version, and remove what it created — stack- and language-agnostic. Never modifies existing source, config, CI or test files: it only adds new files and appends to doc/meta files. Setup also installs two global tooling dependencies (context-mode, caveman), which write outside the repo; both are listed and confirmed first.
